In the blast furnace, the impurity silicon(IV) oxide is removed by the formation of slag.
Which equation represents the formation of the substance which reacts with silicon(IV) oxide to
form slag?
A
C+O2→CO2
B
C+CO2→2CO
C
CaCO3→CaO+CO2
D
Fe2O3+3CO →2Fe+3CO2
subject: Chemistry
